text.en: Most pet owners speak highly of owner Helena and her shop staff, appreciating their helpful advice on pet care and dedication to boarding animals. Customers note that staff go out of their way to assist, even escorting an unwell pet to the vet. One reviewer felt sales tactics were pushy, but overall feedback is positive.

Reviewers emphasize the attentive and caring environment provided for boarding pets, including guinea pigs, rabbits, and budgies. Pet parents report that animals return home healthy, energetic, and clean. Customers express peace of mind knowing their small animals receive regular feeding and plenty of affection.

Pet owners boarding small animals frequently commend the regular communication provided during their time away. Clients appreciate receiving daily photos, messages, and updates via WhatsApp, which help alleviate anxiety about leaving pets. Reviewers highlight this ongoing contact as a major comfort during holidays.

q.en: Does Fur Family Pets provide boarding for small animals?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm boarding services for small animals including guinea pigs, rabbits, and budgies.

q.en: Do pet owners receive updates while their pets are boarded?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention receiving photos, videos, and status updates via WhatsApp while travelling.

q.en: Are basic grooming and nail clipping services offered?

a.en: Customers report bringing rabbits and other small pets to the shop for routine nail trimming and maintenance.
